mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the wheel drives was worthwhile because it explained how different wheel speeds steer the rover without a steering axle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeatedly trying to fit the receiver before the required power components was frustrating; the installation order was not obvious.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the wheel drives could not be mounted until the caster was fitted.

arbitrary.text: The mandatory fitting order felt somewhat arbitrary because the board did not explain why the caster and power components had to come first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the rover draws: the steering and electronics explanations were useful, though I hope the next construction has fewer hidden ordering requirements.
